en: I am very focused now on the societal implications of AI.
zh: 我现在非常关注 AI 对社会的影响。

en: I spent the last several years, you know.
zh: 过去几年里，我一直在做这方面的事，你知道。

en: I was back at Google and, you know.
zh: 我当时回到了 Google，你知道。

en: A lot of the last 15 years have been involved in AI and the technology.
zh: 过去 15 年里，我大部分时间都参与在 AI 和技术领域。

en: And how quickly it is gathering steam.
zh: 以及它的发展势头有多快。

en: How much more advanced it’s getting.
zh: 它正在变得多么先进。

en: How much more advanced it will be in the next decade.
zh: 未来十年它还会变得多么先进。

en: That is something which is going to be wildly more devastating.
zh: 这件事造成的破坏会严重得多。

en: Than any of the consequences of the mismanaged technologies of the last 15 years.
zh: 远远超过过去 15 年那些管理失当的技术所带来的任何后果。

en: And the consequences will crash land on societies all over the world.
zh: 而这些后果会猛烈冲击世界各地的社会。

en: We are not prepared for these things at all.
zh: 我们完全没有为这些事情做好准备。

en: economically, societally, geopolitically, environmentally.
zh: 无论是在经济、社会、地缘政治，还是环境层面。

en: And that’s the agenda that I’m really focused on.
zh: 这就是我真正关注的议题。

en: The tech industry has massively distorted the agenda for how to manage these things.
zh: 科技行业已经严重扭曲了我们该如何管理这些事情的议程。

en: We talk about AI governance.
zh: 我们谈论 AI 治理。

en: And there’s a whole bunch of stuff which is about how you manage the AI systems themselves.
zh: 其中有一大堆内容是在讲如何管理 AI 系统本身。

en: That’s like 1 percent of the problem.
zh: 那大概只占问题的 1%。

en: 15 years from now, probably less than 15 years.
zh: 15 年后，可能还不到 15 年。

en: When a lot of people have lost their jobs to AI.
zh: 当很多人因为 AI 失去工作的时候。

en: And we have no economic solutions.
zh: 而我们没有任何经济解决方案。

en: We have no idea how to give people a good quality of life.
zh: 我们完全不知道该如何让人们过上有质量的生活。

en: That is a much, much bigger problem.
zh: 那才是一个大得多得多的问题。

en: than some of the technical issues we’re facing in those systems.
zh: 比我们在这些系统中面临的一些技术问题要大得多。

en: What happens when AI turbocharged industries consume wildly more resources.
zh: 当 AI 加速发展的行业消耗远超以往的资源时，会发生什么？

en: And they destabilize already reeling ecosystems.
zh: 它们会让已经摇摇欲坠的生态系统更加不稳定。

en: Which we know are hanging by a thread.
zh: 而我们知道，这些生态系统已经命悬一线。

en: And which will impact the lives of millions, if not billions of people.
zh: 并且会影响数百万，甚至数十亿人的生活。

en: Between 2018 and 2023, the world consumed almost as much resources as one third of the 20th century.
zh: 2018 年到 2023 年间，世界消耗的资源几乎相当于 20 世纪三分之一的资源消耗量。

en: And it’s accelerating all the time.
zh: 而且这种速度一直在加快。

en: These are things where in fact big tech companies.
zh: 事实上，在这些事情上，大型科技公司会这样做。

en: They go to government who are desperate for economic growth now.
zh: 它们去找那些现在迫切需要经济增长的政府。

en: A lot of the advanced economies in the global north.
zh: 全球北方的很多发达经济体。

en: They’ve got plateauing growth, they’ve got declining living standards.
zh: 它们增长停滞，生活水平也在下降。

en: They go to them and say.
zh: 科技公司就去对它们说。

en: build this wonder technology, build this infrastructure.
zh: 建设这项神奇的技术，建设这些基础设施。

en: We will give you back the keys to a good future.
zh: 我们会把通往美好未来的钥匙还给你们。

en: Of course, that’s not happening.
zh: 当然，这根本不会发生。

en: This is something which on the present path promises to enrich a tiny sliver of societies.
zh: 按照目前这条路走下去，这件事只会让社会中极小一部分人变得富有。

en: Mostly in the United States, mostly in China.
zh: 主要是在美国，主要是在中国。

en: I think the world we’re going to end up in.
zh: 我认为我们最终会走向的那个世界。

en: in the next 10, 15 years.
zh: 在未来 10 年、15 年里。

en: Is going to be much more unstable than today.
zh: 会比今天不稳定得多。

en: With rapidly declining living standards for hundreds of millions of people.
zh: 数亿人的生活水平会迅速下降。

en: I think a lot of graduates will not be able to get good jobs at all.
zh: 我认为很多毕业生根本找不到好工作。

en: People who did a whole bunch of things in their lives.
zh: 这些人一生中做了很多事情。

en: and were told if they did these things right.
zh: 而且他们被告知，只要把这些事情做好。

en: They would get a good life.
zh: 他们就能过上好日子。

en: And their kids would have better lives than them.
zh: 他们的孩子也会过得比他们更好。

en: That is not going to happen at all on the path they’re on.
zh: 按照他们现在这条路走下去，这根本不会发生。

en: Is the tech industry going to solve these things No.
zh: 科技行业会解决这些问题吗？不会。

en: In fact, they have tried to minimize debate about these things.
zh: 事实上，它们一直试图把关于这些问题的讨论降到最低。

en: They’ve tried to point people back towards the technical solutions.
zh: 它们试图把人们的注意力重新引回技术解决方案。

en: Now it is a moment in which societies and our leaders need to have a mainstream conversation.
zh: 现在正是社会和我们的领导者需要展开主流讨论的时刻。

en: About what the heck we’re going to do to manage all of those effects.
zh: 讨论我们到底该怎么管理所有这些影响。

en: That cannot be left up to the tech industry.
zh: 这件事不能交给科技行业来决定。

en: But now we’re in a situation where.
zh: 但我们现在所处的局面是。

en: Like you said earlier in the conversation.
zh: 就像你刚才在对话中说的那样。

en: The world affected tech and now tech is affecting the world.
zh: 过去是世界影响科技，而现在是科技在影响世界。

en: In the lead up to some of the elections happening in the US.
zh: 在美国一些选举即将到来之际。

en: The tech giants have put together some of the most insane amounts for political campaigns.
zh: 科技巨头已经为政治竞选投入了极其疯狂的资金。

en: They’re going after every single politician.
zh: 它们正在针对每一个政客。

en: Who is proposing any type of restraint or constraint on AI.
zh: 只要这个政客提出任何形式的 AI 限制或约束。

en: Whether we like it or not, money shapes a lot of an election.
zh: 不管我们喜不喜欢，金钱都会在很大程度上塑造一场选举。

en: You have the tech industry fighting to define.
zh: 科技行业正在努力争夺定义权。

en: How it should be managed or it should be governed.
zh: 定义它应该如何被管理，或者应该如何被治理。

en: The people who are going to govern it being funded by them.
zh: 而那些将要治理它的人，却正在接受它们的资金。

en: It seems like an infinite loop that’s for the most part already lost.
zh: 这看起来像是一个无限循环，而且在很大程度上已经输了。

en: Unless something big breaks, as we’ve seen in the past.
zh: 除非有什么重大事件爆发，就像我们过去见过的那样。

en: It’s only when something big breaks that something changes dramatically.
zh: 只有当重大事件爆发时，事情才会发生剧烈改变。

en: I mean I don’t think we should be under any illusions.
zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们不应该抱有任何幻想。

en: The most likely path we’re on.
zh: 我们现在最可能走上的那条路。

en: The one we are on right now.
zh: 也就是我们此刻正在走的这条路。

en: Leads to disaster for our societies and all societies globally.
zh: 会给我们的社会以及全球所有社会带来灾难。

en: I actually don’t think anyone gets out of this thing.
zh: 我其实不认为任何人能从这件事里全身而退。

en: I’ve spent the last six months traveling the world.
zh: 过去六个月，我一直在世界各地旅行。

en: Talking to leaders and a whole bunch of people behind closed doors.
zh: 和各国领导人以及许多幕后人士交谈。

en: Where you have some really spine-tingling conversations.
zh: 在那些场合，你会听到一些真正令人不寒而栗的对话。

en: There’s a strain of opinion, mostly in the US and China.
zh: 有一种观点主要存在于美国和中国。

en: Which thinks we can just win this race for AI.
zh: 他们认为我们只要赢得这场 AI 竞赛就可以了。

en: A bunch of other people will get screwed, but we’ll be okay.
zh: 其他很多人会遭殃，但我们会没事。

en: That’s not going to happen when, of course.
zh: 当然，这种事不会发生。

en: You have societies all over the world that are going to be in chaos.
zh: 因为世界各地的社会都会陷入混乱。

en: No one gets out of this thing in one piece.
zh: 没有人能从这件事里毫发无损地脱身。

en: But we’re in a moment now where I think actually a lot of people across societies.
zh: 但我认为，我们现在正处在这样一个时刻，社会中其实有很多人。

en: Who are paying a bit of attention.
zh: 只要稍微留意一点。

en: They’re seeing things are failing on any number of fronts.
zh: 他们就会看到，很多方面都正在失灵。

en: You look at all the polling.
zh: 你看看所有的民调。

en: Why is it the overwhelming majority of societies in almost all the world.
zh: 为什么几乎全世界绝大多数社会的人。

en: Say things are generally going in the wrong direction.
zh: 都说事情总体上正在朝错误的方向发展？

en: People are angry.
zh: 人们很愤怒。

en: They realize that there aren’t nuances.
zh: 他们意识到，这里面已经没有什么细微差别可言了。

en: There is no vision coming from the top anymore.
zh: 高层已经不再提出任何愿景。

en: In that context, you then have big tech racing to install these systems.
zh: 在这种背景下，大型科技公司还在加速部署这些系统。

en: Where people are now really worried about their jobs.
zh: 而人们现在真的很担心自己的工作。

en: There’s a lot of polling showing that the number one thing.
zh: 有很多民调显示，最让人们感到恐慌的事情。

en: That gets people panicked about AI.
zh: 也就是人们对 AI 感到恐慌的头号原因。

en: Which explains why it is in fact incredibly unpopular with societies.
zh: 这也解释了为什么 AI 在社会中实际上极不受欢迎。

en: Is because they’re worried about their future jobs.
zh: 就是因为他们担心自己未来的工作。

en: This is something where I think actually there’s a lot of people.
zh: 在这件事上，我认为其实有很多人。

en: Who already are looking for a very different approach to how you manage these things.
zh: 已经在寻找一种截然不同的方式来管理这些事情。

en: The debate has not shifted there yet.
zh: 但辩论还没有转向那个方向。

en: Because I think a lot of people don’t understand the scale of what might happen.
zh: 因为我认为很多人还不了解可能发生的事情规模有多大。

en: The speed at which this will unfold.
zh: 也不了解这一切会以多快的速度展开。

en: And how interconnected all these agendas are.
zh: 以及所有这些议题之间有多么相互关联。

en: When people really do understand that the technologies.
zh: 当人们真正理解这些技术的时候。

en: That might give you your amazing apps on your phone.
zh: 这些技术也许能给你的手机带来很棒的应用。

en: Also might be things That destroy the prospect of your kids having future jobs.
zh: 但也可能毁掉你的孩子未来拥有工作的前景。

en: And also will threaten natural ecosystems.
zh: 并且还会威胁自然生态系统。

en: Then it becomes a very different agenda.
zh: 到那时，这就会变成一个完全不同的议题。
